sources.name: Chainguard Free Python OCI image index

evidence.note: Anonymous registry metadata resolved the exact OCI index and selected linux/amd64 manifest sha256:e15765ff7066a0eaf91e1b6fd5000c1bba47d62b9f9731f2da560711d910c4f3; linux/arm64 remains outside this checkpoint.
Chainguard's current directory identifies the Python image as packaged by Chainguard at cgr.dev/chainguard/python.

criteria.note: Publisher, repository, immutable index, and selected platform manifest are exact.

evidence.note: The primary publisher directory names Chainguard as packager and publishes the registry reference, rootless user, entrypoint, OCI labels, and 2026-08-21T17:50:49Z creation time.
Chainguard's official category guide identifies Python as a Base Container intended to be extended by users.

criteria.note: The primary publisher controls the registry artifact and documents the intended base-image use.

evidence.note: The exact digest was anonymously resolvable without an account, secret, terms acceptance, or fee.
The publisher states that Free Containers are publicly available without authentication for download and use.

criteria.note: Only anonymous public access to this exact digest is approved; paid, private, and authenticated images remain outside authority.

evidence.note: The publisher describes Free Containers as free to use for everyone and Base Containers, including Python, as meant to be extended with user applications.

criteria.note: The approved use is anonymous local extension and verification only. This checkpoint may not upload, publish, export, or redistribute base or derived image bytes.

evidence.note: Docker Scout resolved linux/amd64 manifest sha256:e15765ff7066a0eaf91e1b6fd5000c1bba47d62b9f9731f2da560711d910c4f3, config sha256:54c0ed043c48d15cc5043a92ea35540cb7c9620115dae21013c74d72cf98e2fd, eleven content-addressed layers, Chainguard/apko authorship, and three attached in-toto records covering SPDX SBOM, SLSA provenance, and apko image configuration.

criteria.note: The records are bound to the exact platform manifest. Their signatures were observed but not independently verified, so no standalone signature-verification claim is made.

evidence.note: OCI index, platform manifest, config, and eleven layer digests content-address the admitted bytes; Docker Scout reported platform size 26161781 bytes.

criteria.note: The mutable latest tag is not admitted. Local pull and build receipts must reconcile back to the approved index and linux/amd64 manifest before the candidate can pass.

evidence.note: The 101-package resolved SBOM includes Python 3.14.7-r1, SQLite 3.53.4-r0, glibc 2.43-r15, libcrypto3 3.6.3-r5, and libssl3 3.6.3-r5; Python remains compatible with the frozen Python >=3.12 project requirement.
The image has no shell or apk, defaults to UID 65532, and enters through /usr/bin/python; Runbook Sentinel has no runtime dependency beyond the Python standard library.

criteria.note: Fitness is provisional until exact local build, package, CLI, evaluation, API, MCP, approval, executor, dashboard, persistence, telemetry, clean-clone, and repeated-build verification pass.

evidence.note: Docker Scout 1.20.4 returned zero critical/high results. Its generic zero-result SARIF serialization was 461 UTF-8 bytes at SHA-256 7749b34be7a069559b10b1b9d53cc8897576fdd104071a9e0f907f9a301ee303; the command, exact registry reference, and observation time provide the target binding because the SARIF body does not.
The publisher assigns customers responsibility for qualifying pinned updates, testing modifications, maintaining rollback, and patching added application components.

criteria.note: The zero-result scan is observation-time source evidence, not a perpetual CVE-free or finished-product claim. The final gate requires a fresh exact local derived-image scan plus full runtime verification.
